en-us.helper_AVFilming_guide_content:
AV filming and sales consist of several stages: filming, editing, and selling.

Filming: the player needs a %%item_recording_camera%% and a %%item_recording_camera_Tape%%. While holding a %%item_recording_camera%%, you can start %%com_recording_begin_displayName_1%% at any time.
After %%com_recording_end_displayName_1%%, if you have a %%item_recording_camera_Tape%%, it is consumed to produce raw footage.
Without a %%item_recording_camera_Tape%%, nothing is produced.

Editing: use the [%%com_recording_edit_displayName_1%%] command at any %%furniture_computer_terminal%% to start editing.
Pick a [%%recording_edit_canvas_genre_title%%], edit the footage to meet its requirements, then save the recording.
Only after a %%recording_edit_canvas_genre_title%% is set and the recording is saved will the item count as a sellable AV.

Selling: after accepting %%ErAV_Kanon_firstname%%'s offer, the [Miyama Household] can sell AVs anonymously through the Kiryu-gumi's channel.
Make sure the AVs you want to sell are in the [Miyama Household] faction inventory (if not, move them with the Transfer Items To feature under Faction Management).
Later, renting the filmstudio from Kanon creates the [Miyama Pictures] faction as your public studio, which can sell AVs as well.
Then use [%%ui_management_production_addSales%%] to put the target AV on sale.
en-us.helper_UserPref_guide_content:
Change these under [Preferences] -> [Content Settings] on the main menu.

By default, the game does not allow BL interactions, nor futanari -> male (the corresponding training commands cannot be executed). To change which gender interactions are allowed, use [Training Settings] on that screen.
That screen also lets you change which characters the game considers male/female, etc., to fine-tune the conditions for allowed interactions.
